Stated Target Description: 50% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 2030 from a 2021 baseline (443.2 tCO2e); 25% reduction in select Scope 3 categories by 2030 from a 2020 baseline.
Notes: Already surpassed Scope 1+2 target ahead of schedule per third-party trackers. Scope 3 progress lagging baseline. No long-dated net-zero year disclosed. SBTi not validated.

Stated Target Description: 15% reduction in net equity Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 2025 and 30% by 2030 from starting base; aspiration of net zero Scope 1+2 by 2050 or sooner; Scope 3: invest US$5bn in new energy products by 2030 with 5 Mtpa abatement capacity.
Notes: Targets rely on offsets (ACCUs and other carbon credits). 2024 retired 1.3M credits. CTAP rejected by 58% of shareholders at 2024 AGM. Not SBTi-validated.

Stated Target Description: Reduce Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial CO2e emissions by 15% by end-2026, 25% by end-2030, and 50% by end-2035 against a restated 2019 baseline; ambition to achieve net zero industrial CO2e emissions by end-2050 (subject to supportive policy environment).
Notes: 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan published Mar 2024; targets are group-level (Glencore plc) covering Australian operations. Net zero ambition is policy-conditional. Not SBTi-validated.

Stated Target Description: Climate-aligned targets (separated methane and CO2) under Blueprint 2030 strategy; aiming to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions in line with a 1.5C pathway from FY22 baseline (~1189 ktCO2e in FY23); achieved 5.4% gross Scope 1+2 reduction in FY24.
Notes: Targets described as '1.5C-aligned' but specific % reduction quantum to 2030 not clearly stated in public materials reviewed. Methane (~80% of footprint) and CO2 tracked separately. Not SBTi-validated.

Stated Target Description: Subject to Australian Safeguard Mechanism (4.9% annual emissions intensity decline to 2030 against 2020-22 baseline); aligns with Australia's net zero by 2050 commitment; group decarbonisation plan in development; VAM-style project at South Walker Creek under FID.
Notes: No corporate-level quantified Scope 1+2 reduction target beyond regulatory Safeguard obligation. Net zero 2050 is alignment with national policy rather than firm target. High potential BD value.

Stated Target Description: 30% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 (group target) from 2019 baseline; primary lever is VAM (Ventilation Air Methane) capture at Buchanan and Curragh; 60% emission reduction at Buchanan complex by 2030.
Notes: Group is Coronado Global Resources Inc. (NASDAQ/ASX); Australian entity reports under group plan. 2023 SR shows 11% Scope 1+2 reduction achieved. No long-dated net-zero year. Not SBTi-validated.

Stated Target Description: Group-level decarbonisation strategy disclosed via FY24 annual report (operating businesses include Boral concrete/cement which has Boral-specific 2050 net-zero ambition); no consolidated SGH-wide quantified emissions reduction target identified at parent level.
Notes: Most relevant subsidiary climate targets sit at the operating company level (Boral has its own 2050 net zero pathway and FY30 milestones). Recommend a separate look at Boral and WesTrac for granular target verification.

Stated Target Description: Appen's Net Zero Carbon Roadmap sets net zero emissions for business operations by 2025 and net zero emissions across the whole business by 2030. FY25 reporting continues implementing the roadmap and working towards net zero across operations by 2030.
Notes: Latest explicit target document is the 2022 Net Zero Carbon Roadmap; FY25 reporting frames operations net zero as 2030.

Stated Target Description: ASX achieved a 100% reduction in market-based Scope 1 and 2 emissions in FY25 against an FY21 baseline, supported by 99%+ purchased electricity via GreenPower. Net zero S1+S2 in FY25 after offsets.
Notes: Target boundary is Scope 1 and 2 only; residual emissions offset in FY25.

Stated Target Description: Net zero target by 2040 for company and private sector investments; separate 2050 net zero for government bonds and other public sector investments. FY25 reporting tracks portfolio carbon intensity and clean-energy exposure as progress indicators rather than separate near-term targets.
Notes: Latest explicit target-year source is FY22 climate report; FY25 tracks progress metrics.

Stated Target Description: 50% absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG reduction by 2032 from a 2020 baseline; net zero S1+S2 by 2050. Aligned with 1.5°C pathway via SBTi tools but not SBTi-validated.
Notes: Scope 3 target under review per FY25 disclosure.

Stated Target Description: 46.2% absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG reduction by 2030 from a 2019 base year; renewable electricity equivalent to 100% of global power needs by 2028; net zero by 2050. SBTi validation expected in 2026; Scope 3 targets under development.
Notes: Originally submitted to SBTi Dec 2022, re-engaged after methodology changes; validated targets expected 2026.

Stated Target Description: 'Real Zero' to eliminate Scope 1 and 2 emissions from Australian terrestrial iron ore operations in the Pilbara by 2030 (no offsets). Net zero Scope 3 target by 2040; 2030 intensity targets for shipping and steelmaking customers.
Notes: Operational target is 'Real Zero' (no offsets); 2040 net-zero refers to Scope 3 / value chain.

Stated Target Description: 46.2% absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG reduction by 2030 from FY19 baseline; develop Scope 3 target by 2030; 75% green electricity by 2030. SBTi commitment removed in FY24 after declining to commit to Scope 3.
Notes: No current corporate net-zero year stated; FY24 explicitly notes prior SBTi commitment was removed.

Stated Target Description: 100% renewable electricity by 2030; 50% absolute Scope 1+2 reduction by 2030 from 2021 baseline; portfolio temperature alignment to 2.3°C (S1+S2) and 2.5°C (S1+S2+S3) by 2027; long-term net-zero value-chain target by 2050.
Notes: Working toward SBTi verification; not yet validated per FY24/FY25 primary sources.

Stated Target Description: 50% absolute Scope 1+2 reduction by 2030 from FY21 baseline; 25% reduction in Scope 3 by 2030 from FY20 baseline; net zero by 2040.
Notes: Current targets exclude financed emissions; may be revisited after FY26 re-baselining.

Company Name: Stockland Corporation Limited and Stockland Trust
Stated Target Description: Net zero Scope 1 and 2 in 2025; 52% reduction in most material Scope 3 emissions intensity by 2030 from 2021 baseline; net zero Scope 1+2+3 by 2050.
Notes: Near-term operational target = S1+S2 net zero in 2025; whole-of-value-chain net zero is 2050.

Stated Target Description: Net zero carbon Scope 1 and 2 by 2030 in common mall areas across wholly-owned retail assets. FY24/FY25 disclosures show progress against FY16 baseline; no separate quantified near-term reduction target beyond the 2030 endpoint.
Notes: Target boundary narrower than full portfolio — covers common mall areas of wholly-owned retail assets.
